categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Chaoyue Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the environmental protection industry focusing on waste treatment and resource utilization. Its main business segments include industrial hazardous waste disposal, medical waste disposal, waste electrical and electronic equipment dismantling, end-of-life vehicle dismantling, and waste lithium battery recycling and reuse. The company also engages in solid waste testing services and environmental emergency management through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as incineration, landfill, physicochemical treatment, and resource recovery for hazardous waste disposal. It has developed proprietary technologies in waste acid comprehensive utilization, electronic waste modular recycling, and lithium battery material recovery, supported by 86 patents and multiple national and industry standards. The company integrates scientific processing methods with safety and environmental management systems to ensure efficient and compliant operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial enterprises generating hazardous waste, medical institutions producing medical waste, waste appliance recycling companies, vehicle owners and dismantling enterprises, and lithium battery manufacturers or recyclers. The company mainly serves the environmental protection and recycling markets within Anhui Province and the broader Yangtze River Delta region, focusing on hazardous waste treatment, electronic waste recycling, vehicle dismantling, and lithium battery reuse.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Anhui Province, China, with a strategic focus on expanding its influence in the Yangtze River Delta region. Its facilities and subsidiaries are located mainly in Chuzhou City, Anhui. The company’s services and resource recycling efforts are concentrated domestically, with limited cross-provincial hazardous waste transfer due to regulatory constraints.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Chaoyue operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain. It acts as a comprehensive hazardous waste disposal platform, receiving waste from upstream industrial and medical producers, processing and recycling waste materials, and selling recovered resources and products downstream to recycling enterprises and other industrial users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in waste treatment and resource recovery, focusing on developing advanced recycling technologies for hazardous waste, electronic waste, and lithium batteries. It maintains a strong R&D system with national and provincial research centers and collaborates with top universities and research institutes. Key R&D projects include comprehensive utilization of waste lithium batteries, water treatment chemicals from phosphating slag, and advanced dismantling technologies for new energy vehicles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through service fees for hazardous waste and medical waste disposal, sales of recycled materials from dismantled electronic waste and vehicles, and government subsidies related to waste processing volumes. The company also earns income from assembling and selling refurbished lithium battery modules. It operates primarily on a direct sales model with customers picking up products or through contractual service agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading environmental protection enterprise in Anhui Province, recognized as a regional leader in hazardous waste disposal and resource recycling. It holds comprehensive licenses covering 42 of 46 hazardous waste categories nationally and is among a few enterprises qualified for national electronic waste dismantling subsidies. The industry is highly competitive with increasing capacity and price pressures, especially in hazardous waste disposal.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 290.5 million, a 10.24% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 69.34 million, showing a 42.13% reduction in losses. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 1.26 billion with equity of RMB 684 million. Despite losses, the company is expanding capacity and investing in new projects, including lithium battery recycling, indicating a growth trajectory supported by strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui Chaoyue emphasizes its comprehensive hazardous waste disposal capabilities, extensive licensing, and integrated service offerings that cover multiple waste types and treatment methods. Its technological innovation, including patented processes and collaboration with research institutions, differentiates it by enhancing treatment efficiency and environmental safety. The company’s strategic location and government support further strengthen its competitive advantage in providing one-stop, diversified environmental solutions.
